newsitem.title: USA: Evans Systems enters co-branding agreement.
newsitem.headline: Evans Systems enters co-branding agreement.

text.p: Evans Systems Inc said on Monday that it would begin a co-branding relationship with restaurant developer CKE Restaurants Inc with the development of a Hardee's restaurant at Evans Systems' Diamond Mini Mart in Bay City.
Construction of the 4,000 square foot drive-through is scheduled to begin in late May, Evans Systems said in a statement. The facility will also include a gas station and convenience store.
CKE Restaurants Inc, headquartered in Anaheim, Calif., owns and operates 3,152 Hardee's restaurants and 676 Carl's Jr. restaurants.

Evans Systems Inc has four key business segments, including ChemWay Systems, which produces automotive chemical products and reclaims refrigerants, and Convenience Stores, a chain of retail outlets in south Texas and Louisiana.
